profile_note: V15 relative to v14: (D6) sentence_position_gate — candidates falling at clause-mid are filtered by default; only clause-boundary/head/tail candidates are nominated; (D7) immediate_repetition tightened — 2-4 char repetition alone insufficient, requires either duration asymmetry ≥30% between the two occurrences (real stutter signature) OR presence of stutter markers; (D6/D7 provenance) mentor round 2 feedback N003 '不要剪(要保证完整性,这个是在句中)', R-S038 '为什么要剪', R-E306 '这个其实可以不用剪'; all other rules inherit from v14 including D1-D5.

key_feedback.N003_mid_sentence: 不要剪(要保证完整性,这个是在句中)
key_feedback.R-E306_double_issue: 剪辑的不够干净,而且这个其实可以不用剪

sentence_position_gate.conservative_default: if clause_position is unknown/no-track-sem/no-clause, DEFAULT KEEP (do not nominate)

clause_position_source.EP04: semantic-transcript-v1 (codex) — reads clauses[] and computes position by center-of-candidate distance to clause bounds
clause_position_source.EP03_fallback: gap-heuristic — prev_gap and next_gap > 0.4s each → boundary; both < 0.4s → mid

sentence_position_gate.note: D6 explicitly overrides D2/D4 nominations — a filler that survives word-boundary and topic-connective checks BUT falls clause-mid is still rejected. Mentor's explicit priority: '要保证完整性'.

stutter_signature_rules: OR gap_between < 0.15s (very tight repetition, suggests self-correction)
OR presence of stutter marker: 呃/额/嗯/uh/um immediately preceding or between the two occurrences
immediate_repetition_v15.note: v14 单纯的 '两次相同 2-4 字 phrase 间隔 <0.3s' 会过多误报（R-S038 '报告报告'、R-E306 '一个/一个' 都是无 stutter 特征的对称重复，mentor 认为不该剪）。v15 要求至少一个 stutter 特征。

inherited_from_v14.note: 以下条目从 v14 完整继承，未做变更
inherited_from_v14.d4_weak_tokens_split: keep as v14 (backchannel / topic_connective with 对-specific rule / filler)
inherited_from_v14.d5_immediate_repetition_base_thresholds: kept but now gated by D7 stutter_signature

rendering_gate_v15.note: v14 was 50→80→120; v15 起 default 80ms (R-S032 accept 证明 50ms 可以但边界; R-E306/M001/N002 说明 50ms 有时不够). GPT rendering time this floor MUST be enforced.
